title: Timezone Converter
h1: Timezone Converter — Convert Times Across Time Zones
seoTitle: Free Timezone Converter — Convert Time Between Zones
description: Convert a date and time from one time zone to another instantly. See the equivalent time in major cities. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Pick a date and time, choose the source and target time zones, and see the converted time. Useful for scheduling across regions.
blurb: Convert any date and time between different time zones instantly.
howItWorks: Enter a date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format.
Select the source timezone and the target timezone.
Click Convert. The equivalent time in the target zone is shown.
examples: Convert 14:30 in New York to Tokyo time for a meeting.
See what time a London event is in Los Angeles.
Quickly check IST versus UTC for a call.

faq.q: Does it handle daylight saving time?
faq.a: Yes. The browser's built-in timezone data accounts for current DST rules.

faq.q: Is the date sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Conversion happens locally using your browser's timezone support.
Use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, for example 2026-10-22 09:15. Leave blank to use the current time.
